prompt: A split-composition illustration divides the frame down the center: on the left, a strand of DNA unspools into glowing binary code and circuit-like traces, symbolizing genetic sequences being read and rewritten as data; on the right, that same code flows into a stylized cell or microorganism sprouting unnatural, engineered structures—geometric petals, crystalline lattices, tiny gears—representing life forms designed rather than evolved. Faint grid lines and molecular diagrams overlay the entire scene, reinforcing that this fusion of computation and biology is a deliberate, designed process rather than a natural one.
